assets.name: 路面
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this production autumn road texture for a cozy top-down 2D cat game. Keep the original warm biscuit-tan, pale caramel and soft ochre palette, clean rounded cartoon rendering, low detail density and LARGE stone scale. Change only the autumn stone shapes and fallen leaves.
STONE CHANGE: Make these stones moderately more irregular and natural, no longer like a neat brick wall. Keep approximately 12-16 large cobblestones in this square (roughly the current 4-by-4 density), vary width and height by about 20-35%, draw softly rounded asymmetric quadrilaterals and pentagons with slightly angled, gently uneven edges and different corner radii. Interlock them loosely with narrow winding tan joints, avoid identical squares and straight uninterrupted interior rows. Still smooth friendly paving stones, not jagged rocks, not gravel. Quiet broad faces with very subtle flat shading, no grain or tiny speckles.
LEAF CHANGE: Replace the single oval leaf with FIVE recognizably MAPLE-SHAPED fallen leaves, each with a clear 5-point palmate silhouette and short stem, simple flat cartoon shapes. Spread them loosely through the square at different angles and uneven positions, not a grid and not a pile. Muted golden yellow, burnt orange, and a little soft terracotta red, harmonious with the road. Small accents about 6-9% of image width each, leave most paving visible. Keep leaves entirely inside the image, not touching its edges. No other decoration.
SEAM REQUIREMENT: This single texture repeats identically in all four directions. Preserve the reference's boundary layout and stone/joint anchor positions where they meet the four image edges; do not add any new mismatched edge stone. Opposite edges must continue with the same shapes, colors and joint widths at corresponding positions. No perimeter frame, no wider outer gap, no isolated bordered square. Match top to bottom and left to right; no global lighting gradient or dark peripheral shading. Top-down orthographic view, fully painted opaque square RGB PNG, 1024x1024. No characters, objects, words, logo, transparency, perspective, scene border, realistic texture, noise, scratches or micro-detail. Asset autumn_market/road.

assets.name: 墙体
assets.prompt: Input image role: geometry reference showing existing top-down wall grid blocks. Create ONE SINGLE wall-block tile for ONE 32x32 game grid cell, based on the reference's individual square block. Output a square opaque RGB bitmap, ideally1024x1024, with one large plain square wall-top face filling almost the whole canvas. It must NOT contain a row of bricks, multiple tiles, running-bond masonry or a wall surface pattern. Match this geometry: full dark base fills all32x32 cell; one subtly rounded top cap inset about1px left/right and1px top, top cap height about26px; narrow darker solid bottom band about5px creates a shallow raised wall-block effect. Very small light line across top edge, subtle side bevel. Exact top-down 2D orthographic wall-cap icon, no isometric cube and no perspective. warm butter-beige top, muted sage rim and soft olive-gray bottom band. Cute cozy gentle cartoon art, simple matte flat colors, clean warm outlines, no spots, no grain, no realistic texture, no glossy candy reflections. Entire image must be filled and completely opaque RGB, including corner pixels outside the slightly rounded cap, where the darker base color fills in. No blank space, transparency, outer margin, shadow cast outside the block, labels, lettering, floor, plants or background scenery. This one square asset will be drawn once per wall grid cell to form horizontal walls, vertical walls and corners. Production asset autumn_market/wall.
